reviewers.scope: Python DVR, concurrency and resource cleanup
Nx workspace, product website and onboarding
Mobile UI, accessibility and Web Components

proposals.title: Reject redirected Python backend fetches
proposals.author: r01
proposals.scope: Force redirect:error after caller init in PythonBackend.fetch. Keep requests on the explicitly selected backend, including access-code POSTs. Document that redirecting backend URLs must use their final origin. No authentication or EventSource redesign.
proposals.evidence: 307/308 can replay an access-code body at an unselected origin; confirmed with a real Chromium loopback fixture.
proposals.risk: Low; installations relying on redirects must enter the final backend origin.
proposals.validation_plan: Unit test forced policy despite caller override; browser 307/308 receivers receive no configure body; normal same-origin/CORS flow remains valid.

proposals.title: Omit sensitive telemetry object keys
proposals.author: r01
proposals.scope: Drop object entries whose key contains any supplied nonempty saved secret or matches the existing URL expression, before budgeting/copying. Preserve existing private-name filters, limits and benign readings. No claim of current firmware exposure.
proposals.evidence: Accepted synthetic nested JSON keys retain a configured access code and full authenticated source URL in public_stats.
proposals.risk: Low; intentionally removes unusual secret/URL-keyed readings.
proposals.validation_plan: Nested secret/URL key fixtures and safe siblings; no secret or URL in serialized output; existing bounded sanitizer tests.

proposals.title: Sanitize public printer identity metadata
proposals.author: r03
proposals.scope: Sanitize public display name and firmware before identity callback/persistence and sanitize already-saved public metadata on catalog projection. Use the shared URL/saved-code policy. Preserve private verified serial/model used for TLS/topic pairing and avoid redacting private authentication identifiers.
proposals.evidence: Synthetic print.dev_name reaches printers.json and /api/cameras unchanged even though telemetry.status redacts its source URL and access code.
proposals.risk: Low to moderate; private serial must remain intact, including short-code cases.
proposals.validation_plan: Synthetic paired registry checks name/firmware reports, catalog/current/debug/persistence/reload; safe identity unchanged; TLS and subscription serial retained.

proposals.title: Keep access codes bound to verified printer serials
proposals.author: r03
proposals.scope: When discovery verifies a different serial at an endpoint paired to a prior verified serial, quarantine the old pairing, close its associated relay/telemetry clients, and require explicit setup for replacement. Never merge replacement serial into an active old-code binding. Preserve unchanged-serial offline resumption, legacy unpinned records and other endpoints. Document replacement transition and persistence behavior.
proposals.evidence: A synthetic second verified serial at the same endpoint overwrites the paired serial while keeping configured true and old code, including after reload.
proposals.risk: Moderate; pairing lifecycle, active clients and atomic persistence need focused review.
proposals.validation_plan: Pair A then discover B; B cannot use A code or create telemetry before explicit re-pair, including reload. Re-pair B succeeds; repeat A scan/offline restart/metadata delta and unrelated endpoint remain intact; persistence failure covered.

proposals.title: Reset JPEG frame deduplication between sessions
proposals.author: r02
proposals.scope: Reset lastImagePosition on replay close/session reset or scope its cache to session/frame URL. Preserve pause/position semantics and avoid repeated requests within the same session.
proposals.evidence: Seek JPEG A to 30 s, switch B, pause and seek same rounded time: B retains live image because stale dedup key suppresses its historical frame request.
proposals.risk: Low; one legitimate initial frame request for the replacement session.
proposals.validation_plan: Unit fixture switches JPEG A/B and seeks same rounded time; assert B frame URL assigned and paused; existing timeline tests.

proposals.title: Preserve replay intent during automatic media recovery
proposals.author: r02
proposals.scope: Capture session-scoped paused/replay/live intent for automatic transport or decoder reattachment of that same session. Restore seek and pause after readiness; explicit Live and initial/new-session attachment retain intended behavior. Avoid duplicate sessions or native decoders.
proposals.evidence: Source and controller fixture show attachMedia resets followLive and paused; automatic fatal HLS recovery reuses that path. Browser-level confirmation required before implementation.
proposals.risk: Moderate; asynchronous readiness across continuous, HLS and native paths.
proposals.validation_plan: Extend real-browser recovery fixtures for paused rewind and playing replay, retaining session/video/position or offset. Live recovery still progresses, Chromium/WebKit; unit intent lifecycle.

proposals.title: Bound finite-file timeline prediction at duration
proposals.author: r02
proposals.scope: Apply known finite native file duration as hard cap to display edge prediction while retaining pre-EOF live interpolation. Keep HLS six-second prediction unchanged.
proposals.evidence: Finite file at EOF predicts six nonexistent seconds and displays artificial negative replay offset despite seek bounds clamped to duration.
proposals.risk: Low when limited to kind=file with finite duration.
proposals.validation_plan: Unit tests near EOF and after EOF advance clock; edge and max never exceed duration, no fake end offset; pre-EOF equal-rate replay stays stable; HLS interpolation unchanged.
